title: Sunny 2 Queen BR w/ Deck in Heart of Nashville
description:
Stay in this newly built spacious apartment and live like a true local in Nashville. We're just a short Uber to all of Nashville's best-known restaurants, bars, and attractions. 

Our 2 Queen bedroom apartment comes with a luxurious shower (completed with 3 heads), a fully stocked kitchen, comfy living room, in-unit washer/dryer, and don't forget the outdoor deck w/ ample seating to enjoy the downtown views.

Our sole focus is on creating the best guest experience & ensuring you're comfortable.
